evidence.snippet: Some of the potential SAP plan components can include: Timely submission of coursework Regular communication with professors Repeating required classes that were not passed Time management strategies Test-taking strategy development Regular academic participation As needed Success Coach meetings Professional Judgement What is Professional Judgement?
Professional Judgment (PJ) may be utilized for special circumstances that the FAFSA does not take into consideration.
Professional Judgment is the process of having the ORU Financial Aid Office override FAFSA data for federally-approved situations using reasonable methods for adjusting the FAFSA data inputs.

Professional Judgment is also used for students who are considered Dependent by FAFSA but have unusual family circumstances that allow the ORU Financial Aid Office to determine the student is Independent for FAFSA.
